question.text: Let <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>R</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>S</mi><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> represent the diagonals of the parallelogram <math><mi>P</mi><mi>Q</mi><mi>R</mi><mi>S</mi></math>. If <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> is another vector, then the volume (in cubic units) of the parallelepiped formed by the vectors <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>T</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>Q</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>P</mi><mi>S</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is

solution.text:
Here,

PQ→+PS→=PR→PQ→-PS→=SQ→

⇒PQ→=12PR→+SQ→

⇒PQ→=2i^-j^-3k^

Also, PS→=12PR→-SQ→

=i^+2j^+k^

Volume of parallelepiped =PT→ PQ→ PS→

=2-112-1-3121

=25+15+15=20 cubic units
